<html>
<head>
  <title>Zoty - RTP export</title>
</head>
<body>
{{#if pageCover}}
  <div class="page">
    <div class="pageIntro">
      <div class="u_textCenter">
        <img width="175" style="margin-top: 20px;" src="data:image/png;base64," />
      </div>
      <div class="pageIntro_center">
        <div class="fsXL u_textCenter">        
          <h1 class="section_title">{{pageCover.title }}</h1>
          {{#if pageCover.subtitle}}
            <h2 class="cGray">{{ pageCover.subtitle }}</h2>
          {{/if}}
          {{#if pageCover.headline}}
            <h2 class="cGray">{{ pageCover.headline }}</h2>
          {{/if}}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="pageIntro_bottom">
        <table class="table-darkBlocks u_widthFull fsL">
          <tr>
            <th style="horizontal-alignment: center">
              <span class="cGray">{{ getTranslation 'common.generatedBy' 'Generated by' }}:&nbsp;</span>
              <span class="fsL">{{ _me.firstName }} {{ _me.lastName }}</span>
            </th>
            <th style="horizontal-alignment: center">
              <span class="cGray">{{ getTranslation 'common.date' 'Date' }}:&nbsp;</span>
              <span class="fsL">{{ formatDate dateToday 'l, LT' }}</span>
            </th>
          </tr>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
{{/if}}
{{#if dataEntity}}
  {{#if dataEntity.nameTranslated}}
    <div class="spaceL">{{> pageTitle data=dataEntity.nameTranslated }}</div>
  {{/if}}
  <table class="counterBox spaceL">
    <tr>
      <td width="33%">
        <div class="counterBox_card">
          <span class="section_titleGroup">{{ getTranslation 'common.costsMeasure' 'Náklady opatření' }}</span>
          <div class="counterBox_counter">
            <span>{{#ifCond dataMap.costsTotal '!==' null}}{{ dataMap.costsTotal }}{{else}}—{{/ifCond}}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </td>
      <td width="33%">
        <div class="counterBox_card">
          <span class="section_titleGroup">{{ getTranslation 'measure.allocated' 'Alokováno' }}</span>
          <div class="counterBox_counter">
            <span>{{#ifCond dataMap.costs '!==' null}}{{ dataMap.costs }}{{else}}—{{/ifCond}}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </td>
      <td width="33%">
        <div class="counterBox_card">
          <span class="section_titleGroup">{{ getTranslation 'common.difference' 'Rozdíl' }}</span>
          <div class="counterBox_counter">
            <span>{{#ifCond dataMap.costsDifference '!==' null}}{{ dataMap.costsDifference }}{{else}}—{{/ifCond}}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </td>
    </tr>
  </table>
  <h3 class="section_title">
    <svg viewBox="64 64 896 896" class="section_title_icon" data-icon="attributes" width="1em" height="1em" fill="#bbb">
      <path d="M120 230h496c4.4 0 8-3.6 8-8v-56c0-4.4-3.6-8-8-8H120c-4.4 0-8 3.6-8 8v56c0 4.4 3.6 8 8 8zm0 424h496c4.4 0 8-3.6 8-8v-56c0-4.4-3.6-8-8-8H120c-4.4 0-8 3.6-8 8v56c0 4.4 3.6 8 8 8zm784 140H120c-4.4 0-8 3.6-8 8v56c0 4.4 3.6 8 8 8h784c4.4 0 8-3.6 8-8v-56c0-4.4-3.6-8-8-8zm0-424H120c-4.4 0-8 3.6-8 8v56c0 4.4 3.6 8 8 8h784c4.4 0 8-3.6 8-8v-56c0-4.4-3.6-8-8-8z"></path>
    </svg> {{ getTranslation 'attribute_pl' 'Atributy' }}
  </h3>
  <table class="table-borderBottom spaceM" style="border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; width: 100%;">
    <tr>
      <td class="labelDark">Správce:</td>
      <td>{{{dataEntity.owner}}}</td>
      <td class="labelDark">Autor:</td>
      <td>{{{dataEntity.author}}}</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td class="labelDark">Stav:</td>
      <td>{{dataEntity.state}}</td>
      <td class="labelDark">Organizace:</td>
      <td>
        {{#each dataEntity.groupList as |group|}}{{#if @index }}, {{/if}}{{group.nameTranslated}}{{/each}}
      </td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td class="labelDark">Platnost:</td>
      <td class="u_noWrap">{{ formatDate dataEntity.validFrom 'l' }}{{#if dataEntity.validTo}} – {{ formatDate dataEntity.validTo 'l' }}{{/if}}</td>
      <td></td>
      <td></td>
    </tr>    
    <tr>
      <td class="labelDark">Vytvořeno:</td>
      <td>{{ formatDate dataEntity.createdAt 'l, LT' }}</td>
      <td class="labelDark">Upraveno:</td>
      <td>{{ formatDate dataEntity.updatedAt 'l, LT' }}</td>
    </tr>
  </table>
{{/if}}
{{#if dataEntity.descriptionTranslated}}
  <div class="description spaceTop spaceM">{{ dataEntity.descriptionTranslated }}</div>
{{/if}}
{{#with componentFiles}}
  {{> pageComponent class="spaceL" }}  
{{/with}}
<h3 class="section_title">
  <svg viewBox="64 64 896 896" class="section_title_icon" data-icon="entities" width="1em" height="1em" fill="#bbb">
    <path d="M854.6 288.6L639.4 73.4c-6-6-14.1-9.4-22.6-9.4H192c-17.7 0-32 14.3-32 32v832c0 17.7 14.3 32 32 32h640c17.7 0 32-14.3 32-32V311.3c0-8.5-3.4-16.7-9.4-22.7zM790.2 326H602V137.8L790.2 326zm1.8 562H232V136h302v216a42 42 0 0 0 42 42h216v494z"></path>
  </svg> {{ getTranslation 'risk_pl' 'Rizika' }}
</h3>
{{#each contentList as |content|}}
  <div class="section_card spaceM">
    <div class="section_card_header"><h5>{{ content.title }}</h5></div>     
    {{#each content.componentList as |component|}}
      {{#if @last}}
        {{> pageComponent class="spaceZero" }}
        {{else}}
        {{> pageComponent class="spaceM" }}
      {{/if}}
    {{/each}}
  </div>  
{{/each}}
{{#if signature}}
  <div class="signature breakAvoid">
    <div class="fGeorgia fsL" style="height: 10em;">
      <i>{{ signature.appendBefore }}</i>
    </div>
    <div style="width: 40%; margin-bottom: .5em; border-bottom: 1px dashed #ccc;"></div>
    {{ signature.appendAfter }}
  </div>
{{/if}}
</body>
</html>
